subQuestion.content: Describe the picture?
subQuestion.suggestion:
As I can see in the first picture, there is a young woman sitting in a greenhouse. She is picking red tomatoes and placing them into a basket. The greenhouse is full of fresh vegetables, creating a peaceful atmosphere.


On the other hand, in the second picture, I see a father and his young child working together in a garden. The father is helping the child plant yellow flowers, using small tools and a watering can. It looks like they are in their backyard, enjoying time together.


Both pictures show people working with plants, but in different ways. I prefer the first image because I enjoy seeing fresh vegetables being picked. However, the second image also looks nice because it shows a father and child spending time together.

subQuestion.content: Growing a garden has many wonderful benefits?
subQuestion.suggestion:
It allows people to have fresh vegetables and beautiful flowers, making their surroundings healthier and more attractive. Gardening also helps reduce stress, improves mental well-being, and encourages physical activity, which is good for overall health. Moreover, it teaches patience and responsibility, as plants require daily care, watering, and attention to grow properly. In addition, gardening can be a rewarding and relaxing hobby, giving people a sense of accomplishment when they see their plants grow and thrive. It also promotes environmental awareness, as people learn how to take care of nature and appreciate the beauty of green spaces.

Đóng

subQuestion.content: Growing vegetables and flowers is appealing for many reasons?
subQuestion.suggestion:
Vegetables provide fresh, nutritious food, reducing grocery expenses and promoting a healthy diet. Homegrown produce is often tastier and free from harmful chemicals, making it a better option for families. Flowers, on the other hand, make any space more colorful, attractive, and peaceful, creating a pleasant and welcoming atmosphere. Both activities offer a deep connection with nature, a sense of accomplishment, and the joy of watching plants flourish over time. Additionally, gardening can be a great way to spend time outdoors, socialize with others who share the same interest, and develop new skills related to plant care and sustainability.

Đóng

Person B:

I have always preferred traditional sports such as swimming and running because they keep me healthy without being too dangerous. Still, I wanted to know what an extreme sport would feel like, so last year I tried bungee jumping while on holiday. At first, I was extremely nervous, but when I finally jumped, the feeling was unforgettable. It gave me a thrill that swimming never could. Even so, I still practice swimming every week because it’s safer and more practical, but I admit that extreme sports can be fun if you try them at least once.


Person C:

Some of my friends invited me to join them for snowboarding and paragliding, but I always said no. It’s not that I don’t like sports—I enjoy cycling and tennis—but I don’t see the point of risking my health just to feel a few seconds of excitement. To me, extreme sports are not important for a happy life, and I avoid them whenever possible.


Person D:

What I really enjoy about extreme sports is that they often take place in nature. Last summer, I went kayaking on a wild river, and the scenery was breathtaking. I also tried mountain biking in the forest, and I loved the feeling of fresh air and freedom. It’s not just about the sport itself, but about being surrounded by mountains, trees, and water. A: When I first graduated from school, I wasn’t sure what to do, so I joined several volunteer programs with different companies and organizations to gain experience. I really enjoyed volunteering because it helped me decide on a career path and gave me many valuable lessons. I also believe I was able to make a difference through my work.

B: Back in school, I already knew I wanted to become a teacher, so I didn’t need to try other jobs. I decided to study education at university, which is free in my country. Last summer, I did some practical training in local schools, and it was extremely helpful for my future career.

C: When I was young, I used to help my neighbor, a plumber, with simple jobs like measuring pipes, loosening screws, and handling tools. It felt very natural for me to learn that kind of work, so later I studied for two years at university to become an electrician. Now, I’ve learned that there are shorter courses available in this field, and I regret not choosing that option instead.

D: After graduating, I found it really difficult to get a job. I applied to many companies, but none accepted me because I lacked experience. Eventually, I found work at a gaming company that allowed me to work from home. It didn’t affect my daily schedule — I worked at night while my colleagues worked during the day — and that arrangement suited me perfectly.

Here is the perspective of four people on the above topic. Please read the content and answer the question.

A: This was my first time attending the Music Festival, and to be honest, the weather really didn't cooperate. It rained heavily on the first two days, which made it difficult to enjoy the outdoor activities. I still got wet in the tent. But I didn't let that ruin the experience. On the final day, the skies cleared up and the performances were truly amazing - especially the final act in the evening. That last day made it all worthwhile, and I left with some great memories despite the poor weather.


B: I've been to this festival a couple of times in the past, the quality was good the last times I came, but this time is completely different. The sound quality wasn't great, and the whole event just felt disorganised. There weren't enough facilities, and the staff didn't seem prepared to handle the crowd. I couldn't even interact with the band. I don't think I'll be coming back next year. It's simply not worth the money or the time anymore.


C: The festival this year had one of the best line-ups I've seen so far. I absolutely loved the energy of the performances, and the music was spot on throughout the weekend. However, I have to say the ticket prices were far too high, especially for students. I paid almost double what I did two years ago, and although I enjoyed the music, I'm not sure it offered good value for money. If they don't lower the prices next year, a lot of people might skip it.


D: We were playing in a band and we finished our performance in the morning. However, I stayed at the festival to meet up with some old band mates. We talked a lot. However, I didn't like the venue. It was too crowded and not well organised. The road to the tent village was also congested. I think they should choose a better location next year.

Chọn đáp án đúng:

1.Even before the nineteenth century, mountains had always been a magnet for travelers. They attracted people simply because of their natural beauty, and climbing to the summit to enjoy the view was one of the pleasures of adventurers. Today, although mountain peaks remain popular destinations, the meaning of climbing them has changed. Reaching the summit is no longer only about sightseeing but has become a symbol of success and achievement. For many, it represents a once-in-a-lifetime challenge that they want to accomplish in order to feel fulfilled, rather than just a scenic excursion.


2. For many climbers, reaching the top of a mountain carries a deeper meaning. The “summit” is often seen as a metaphor for success in life, while the obstacles faced during the climb are viewed as personal challenges. Over time, this act has developed into a cultural pursuit, where mountaineering is connected to adventure, risk, and self-affirmation. What climbers encounter or see along the route seems to matter less compared to the pride of standing at the peak. In this way, the journey itself is often overshadowed by the final accomplishment.


3. The idea of climbing as an “achievement” has become especially widespread with the rise of the so-called “summit selfie.” Even before social media, taking a photo at the top was considered one of the most important parts of the climb. At first, this was simply a way to preserve a memory, but later it became a means of sharing the experience with others. Social platforms have intensified this trend, as many people now care less about the journey itself and more about capturing a picture at the summit. For some, the climb is no longer about nature or exploration but about evidence of success to be seen by others.


4. The photograph captured by Ethan Crawford in 1993 exposed the unsettling reality of contemporary mountaineering. The image showed hundreds of people queuing in line to reach the mountain’s peak, something once reserved for true explorers. Instead of faces filled with determination and excitement, the photo revealed exhaustion and impatience. After being shared widely on social media, the image sparked a heated debate about whether climbing to the summit has lost its original meaning. Many began to question if the act is still about exploration or if it has been reduced to nothing more than a competitive display.


5. From this photograph, critics argue that reaching the summit remains a desirable goal for many, though often for different reasons. However, they suggest that people are ignoring the multifaceted nature of mountaineering. For some climbers, neither the journey nor the true experience of reaching the top seems to matter, since they are merely following a trend. In reality, climbing requires much more, including but not limited to physical preparation, financial planning, and logistical organization. Without these elements, the act of mountaineering becomes superficial rather than meaningful.


6. One major argument circulating online is that this trend-driven approach to climbing should come to an end. Popular mountains have been left with excessive amounts of waste, raising concerns about environmental damage. For this reason, activists stress that people should climb more responsibly. They contend that, regardless of personal goals, reaching the top is only worthwhile when the journey itself is a positive and respectful experience. Otherwise, the achievement loses its true value.


7. Perhaps it is time to change the way people think about mountaineering and return to its original spirit. In her memoir, Charlie Bennett once described how walking up a mountain allowed her to enjoy the landscape, slow down, and reconnect with nature. “For me, climbing was never about rivalry or recognition; it was about moving quietly, letting the mountain set the rhythm, and discovering joy in simply being present. Each step felt like an invitation to reflect, to connect with nature, and to find calm in the stillness of the journey. This is why I believe the true essence of mountaineering is not conquest, but appreciation — an experience that is both deeply personal and profoundly natural.

1. With the emergence of the four-day working week, the traditional five-day schedule is increasingly being challenged. Many firms still cling to industrial-age models, assuming that long working hours guarantee efficiency. Yet, such assumptions no longer reflect the needs of modern employees. Today’s workforce values flexibility and wellbeing just as much as income. In fact, a rigid timetable often leads to burnout rather than productivity. It is becoming clear that the conventional system is steadily losing relevance.

 

2. The four-day working week has become highly relevant in today’s context of fast-paced living. The five-day system offers little time for proper rest or personal commitments. This is particularly demanding for women, who often balance professional duties with family responsibilities. A shorter schedule would allow employees to recharge and spend quality time with their loved ones. As a result, workers are more likely to be motivated and engaged in their jobs. In the long run, this can enhance both personal happiness and workplace morale.

 

3. Despite its advantages, many corporations remain sceptical of the four-day model. Employers often fear that fewer hours will inevitably reduce productivity and profitability. These concerns are not entirely groundless. For example, a British company that trialled the scheme reported a 30% fall in performance. In Stevension City, the introduction of this policy resulted in losses of around 30 million dollars within a single month. Such evidence makes some businesses wary of adopting the reform on a large scale.

 

4. At first glance, the four-day week appears to provide employees with greater freedom and better balance. Companies that have introduced the policy often report that work is still completed within the shorter timeframe. However, hidden drawbacks are starting to surface. Studies show that compressed hours can lead to more mistakes and higher stress levels. Workers sometimes take unfinished tasks home, undermining the very purpose of the reform. These challenges raise doubts about the long-term sustainability of the model.

 

5. Difficult to change entrenched habits

Psychological studies suggest that while the shorter week initially improves morale, the effect quickly fades. Employees often feel happier in the first stage because of the sudden increase in free time. Yet, after a period of adjustment, their emotional state tends to return to its normal level. Some even experience boredom or frustration once the novelty wears off. As a result, workers may start engaging in unpaid tasks or working from home to fill the gap. This pattern suggests that structural change alone may not guarantee lasting satisfaction.

 

6. Unfair for certain groups

Although the four-day week benefits many, certain professions find it far less practical. Teachers, for example, still have to cover the same amount of material and manage the same number of students. Compressing this workload into fewer days risks lowering educational quality. The police force faces similar obstacles, since crime does not decrease simply because officers are off duty. In such fields, reducing working days could lead to serious inefficiencies. Therefore, blanket application of the policy may create inequality across different sectors.

 

7. Alternative solutions worth considering

Rather than implementing a universal four-day week, organisations could consider more flexible alternatives. Options such as reducing daily working hours, offering longer paid leave, or increasing financial incentives might prove equally effective. These approaches allow employees to enjoy better balance without disrupting productivity. Furthermore, companies could invest in digital tools and training to improve efficiency. A gradual shift towards flexibility may reduce resistance from employers. Ultimately, a tailored strategy may offer greater benefits than a one-size-fits-all solution.

questions.content:
1. For many years, a workweek of five or even six days was the standard. However, advancements in technology, evolving social values, and an increasing emphasis on work-life balance are making this traditional schedule less relevant. Both employees and employers are starting to question whether spending the majority of one’s week at work is truly necessary or productive.


2. Proponents of a four-day workweek highlight various benefits for workers. With an extra day off, employees gain more time to recharge, connect with family, or explore personal interests. Research shows that shorter workweeks can enhance focus and efficiency, leading to improved job performance and higher levels of job satisfaction.


3. While appealing, a reduced workweek could have financial downsides. Companies might incur higher expenses from the need to hire additional staff or adjust compensation models. For sectors that rely on hourly employees, it may be difficult to maintain profitability, potentially leading to service reductions or job cuts.


4. Adapting to a new work schedule can be difficult for some employees. The pressure to complete tasks within a shorter timeframe can lead to stress, and fast-paced industries may face challenges such as missed deadlines or conflicting schedules, complicating the transition to a shorter workweek.


5. For individuals accustomed to traditional work hours, the shift to a four-day workweek can be challenging. Breaking long-established routines is tough, and some may resist change even when it offers potential benefits. Adapting to a new work pattern often requires time and support.


6. While a four-day workweek may sound ideal to many, it isn’t necessarily fair to all. Essential workers, healthcare providers, and employees in the hospitality industry may not have the option to reduce their hours. This could create disparities among different worker groups and lead to tension within the workforce.


7. Rather than universally implementing a four-day workweek, experts suggest considering more flexible arrangements. Options such as allowing employees to choose their days off or offering shorter daily hours can provide similar advantages without disrupting industries that depend on a traditional work schedule.

1. In recent years, the definition of health has broadened to encompass more than just physical well-being. Holistic approaches emphasize the interconnection of the body, mind, and environment, encouraging individuals to consider emotional balance, mental clarity, nutrition, and lifestyle habits collectively. This more comprehensive view helps people achieve deeper and more sustainable wellness by addressing various aspects of life rather than isolated symptoms.


2. Mental health has become a growing priority in public health discussions. Awareness campaigns aim to reduce the stigma surrounding mental health disorders and encourage open conversations about personal struggles. Educating people on recognizing early signs of anxiety, depression, and stress empowers them to seek help sooner. Many organizations also provide support networks and resources to build a more compassionate and understanding society.


3. Community-based fitness initiatives are becoming more popular as a way to make exercise enjoyable and accessible. By participating in group activities such as yoga, walking clubs, or sports leagues, individuals not only improve their physical health but also form meaningful social connections. These programs foster a sense of belonging and help individuals stay committed to their fitness goals over time, contributing to healthier and happier communities.


4. Although trendy diets often promise quick weight loss or improved health, relying too heavily on these fads can be problematic. Many popular diets lack scientific support and may eliminate essential nutrients, leading to unbalanced nutrition. Nutrition experts emphasize that sustainable eating should focus on balanced meals, moderation, and individual needs rather than quick fixes. Building a healthy relationship with food is more beneficial than chasing the latest diet trend.


5. The rise of social media and online platforms has led to widespread sharing of health information, but not all of it is accurate or safe. Misinformation about supplements, treatments, and health practices can cause confusion or even harm. It’s crucial for individuals to critically assess sources, consult healthcare professionals, and rely on evidence-based guidance when making decisions about their wellness routines.


6. Supportive wellness-focused communities play an essential role in helping people maintain healthy lifestyles. Whether online or through local meetups, these groups offer encouragement, share tips, and provide accountability. Members can exchange experiences, celebrate successes, and find motivation during challenges, creating an environment where individuals feel empowered to achieve their health goals.


7. Achieving long-term health requires more than temporary diets or exercise bursts. Sustainable wellness involves making gradual changes that can be maintained over time, such as improving sleep habits, managing stress, and incorporating regular physical activity. By setting realistic goals and making incremental adjustments, individuals are more likely to experience lasting benefits and enhance their overall quality of life.

questions.content:
1. Achievements often go unnoticed when gender biases come into play. Many groundbreaking contributions from women in science, technology, and other fields are overshadowed by societal expectations, leading to a lack of recognition for their hard work and dedication.


2. Recognizing the accomplishments of pioneering women is essential for breaking stereotypes and inspiring future generations. Women like Marie Curie, Ada Lovelace, and Katherine Johnson changed the world with their brilliance, yet their achievements were often marginalized due to their gender.


3. Men are unfairly given credit for work that was often a joint effort or even led by women. History has been shaped by this bias, where the achievements of women were either ignored or misattributed, despite their immense contributions to progress.


4. A long career is a testament to one's exceptional abilities. Take the story of a female engineer who spent decades improving infrastructure in underdeveloped regions. Despite her groundbreaking work, she was often overlooked simply because of her gender, but her work left an indelible mark on society.


5. Labels can change perceptions dramatically. The label of 'genius' or 'pioneer' is often reserved for men, but when a woman is labeled in the same way, it challenges stereotypes and forces society to recognize her contributions. This shift in perception is key to breaking down barriers and opening doors for others.


6. Striving to create gender balance in the workplace and society at large has become a movement. Companies and governments are starting to realize that diverse teams lead to better solutions, yet the struggle for equal representation continues. The push for gender balance is not just about fairness but also about enhancing productivity and creativity.


7. Uniformity can be a disadvantage in many settings. When everyone is expected to conform to the same mold, innovation and individuality suffer. The story of a diverse team at a tech startup shows how embracing different perspectives led to creative breakthroughs, proving that diversity is a powerful asset.

data.title: Mountain Summits ( phiên bản 2) Cùng đáp án với các đề Mountain Submits

questions.content:
1. In the early 1800s, people were believed not to enjoy climbing mountains. Later, as mountain climbing became a popular trend, interest grew rapidly. However, there is evidence that humans have always been fascinated by mountains. The difference now is that people focus mainly on reaching the summit to admire the majestic views rather than simply exploring the mountain itself.


2.Climbing to the top of a mountain creates the same adrenaline rush as other extreme sports. But it goes far beyond that. Because of the sheer size and grandeur of the mountains, the experience becomes a powerful metaphor, making climbers feel deeply inspired. This intense feeling can even become addictive, as people unconsciously develop a strong desire to keep reaching the peak.


3.People have always enjoyed capturing and sharing the moment of standing on a mountaintop. This practice existed even before social media, as climbers admired the view or described their experiences to others. With the rise of social media, this trend has become even more common. Now, almost everyone takes selfies and posts them online for friends and family to see after reaching the summit.


4.Recently, some climbers have begun questioning whether this focus on the summit is truly meaningful. The most beautiful views might not be from the peak itself, and the path to the summit is often exhausting, requiring great physical strength. This approach excludes many people and overlooks the beauty found all along the mountain, not just at the top.


5.A photo taken on Mount Everest in 2020, showing a “traffic jam” of climbers, shocked the world. It revealed how many climbers were rushing to reach the summit during the short window of good weather. This image raised concerns about overcrowding and highlighted how Everest, once seen as a remote and unreachable peak, has now become a site of intense competition and environmental strain.


6.The viral photo made some people feel that climbing Everest had lost its charm. However, mountain climbing itself is not the problem. Instead, climbers must carefully reflect on their goals and habits, ensuring that future global tourism does not negatively impact the environment. A more mindful approach can protect mountains for generations to come.


7.Perhaps we should approach mountains with a gentle mindset, seeing them as companions rather than challenges to conquer. In the 1940 book The Living Mountain by Shepherd, the author describes climbing near her family farm. She wandered the mountains without specific goals, treating each climb as a visit to old friends instead of a mission to claim victory over nature.

questions.content:
1.In recent years, the definition of health has broadened to encompass more than just physical well-being. Holistic approaches emphasize the interconnection of the body, mind, and environment, encouraging individuals to consider emotional balance, mental clarity, nutrition, and lifestyle habits collectively. This more comprehensive view helps people achieve deeper and more sustainable wellness by addressing various aspects of life rather than isolated symptoms.


2.Mental health has increasingly become a priority in public health discussions. Awareness campaigns aim to reduce the stigma around mental illnesses and encourage people to talk openly about their struggles. Providing education on recognizing early signs of anxiety, depression, and stress empowers individuals to seek help sooner. Many organizations also offer support networks and resources to foster a more compassionate and understanding society.


3.Community-based fitness initiatives are gaining popularity as a way to make exercise more enjoyable and accessible. By participating in group activities like yoga classes, walking clubs, or sports leagues, people not only improve their physical health but also build meaningful social connections. These programs create a sense of belonging and motivate individuals to stick with their fitness goals over time, contributing to healthier and happier communities.


4.Although trendy diets often promise quick weight loss or improved health, relying too heavily on these fads can be problematic. Many popular diets lack scientific support and may eliminate essential nutrients, leading to unbalanced nutrition. Nutrition experts emphasize that sustainable eating should focus on balanced meals, moderation, and individual needs rather than quick fixes. Building a healthy relationship with food is more beneficial than chasing the latest diet trend.


5.The rise of social media and online platforms has led to widespread sharing of health information, but not all of it is accurate or safe. Misinformation about supplements, treatments, and health practices can cause confusion or even harm. It’s crucial for individuals to critically assess sources, consult healthcare professionals, and rely on evidence-based guidance when making decisions about their wellness routines.


6.Supportive wellness-focused communities play an essential role in helping people maintain healthy lifestyles. Whether online or through local meetups, these groups offer encouragement, share tips, and provide accountability. Members can exchange experiences, celebrate successes, and find motivation during challenges, creating an environment where individuals feel empowered to achieve their health goals.


7.Achieving long-term health requires more than temporary diets or exercise bursts. Sustainable wellness involves making gradual changes that can be maintained over time, such as improving sleep habits, managing stress, and incorporating regular physical activity. By setting realistic goals and making incremental adjustments, individuals are more likely to experience lasting benefits and enhance their overall quality of life.

data.title: Mountain (phiển bản 4) đáp án giống moutain Submits (version 2, 3)

questions.content:
1. In the modern consciousness, the definition of a mountain has evolved far beyond its geological description as a massive landform of rock and ice. Historically viewed as sacred barriers or purely natural entities, mountains are increasingly defined by humans as 'vertical arenas' for personal testing. This conceptual shift transforms the mountain from a part of the ecosystem into a commodity—a challenge to be overcome rather than a landscape to be respected.


2.This new definition is driven by a powerful psychological reward: the unique feeling of achievement. When a climber pushes their physical limits to reach a summit, the combination of exhaustion and altitude creates a potent cocktail of adrenaline and pride. It is a singular sensation of conquering the impossible, offering a temporary escape from the mundane routines of daily life. This internal 'high' creates a deep-seated desire to return.


3.However, in our hyper-connected era, internal satisfaction is rarely enough; it is the publicity of achievement that now drives the masses. The solitude of the peaks is often broken by the need to document and broadcast the success on social media. The mountain becomes a backdrop for digital validation, where the value of the climb is measured in likes and shares rather than personal growth.


4.The obsession with public recognition inevitably establishes the wrong priority. Instead of prioritizing safety, skill acquisition, or the appreciation of nature's subtle beauty, many climbers become fixated solely on 'bagging the peak'. This 'summit fever' encourages rushing, dangerous shortcuts, and a lack of preparation. The journey itself is ignored in a frantic race to the top, reducing the majestic experience to a mere checklist item.


5.This distorted mindset leads to a disturbing relevant—a troubling reality where our ego directly impacts the environment. As more people flock to the mountains with the wrong priorities, we witness a direct correlation between human traffic and environmental degradation. Trails are eroded, campsites are littered with non-biodegradable waste, and delicate wildlife habitats are disturbed.


6.Facing this ecological crisis, the mountaineering community is being forced to shift its focus on sustainability. We are realizing that the mountains are finite resources that cannot withstand endless abuse. This creates a new imperative: implementing stricter limits on climber numbers, enforcing 'leave no trace' policies, and promoting ethical tourism. The goal is shifting from conquering the land to preserving it.



7.Ultimately, this move toward preservation fosters a more intimate relationship with the mountain. When we stop viewing the peak as an enemy to defeat or a trophy to display, we begin to see it as a partner. This new relationship is built on humility, silence, and deep respect for the natural world. We learn to climb not just to stand on the mountain, but to be with the mountain.

questions.content: You are a member of an Art club. You are talking to other members in the club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.
questions.suggestion:
A. I kept a painting for a long time. Tell me a thing that you have had for a long time.

Giải: Experience - Trải nghiệm

If my memory serves me right, it was 10 years ago. I had a long journey alone to Hue by train. On this trip, I bought a landscape painting. I still keep that painting until now because it reminds me of the happy memories of the trip.

(Dịch: Nếu tôi nhớ không nhầm thì đó là 10 năm trước. Tôi đã có một chuyến đi dài một mình đến Huế bằng tàu hỏa. Trong chuyến đi này, tôi đã mua một bức tranh phong cảnh. Tôi vẫn giữ bức tranh đó cho đến bây giờ vì nó gợi lại cho tôi những kỷ niệm vui vẻ của chuyến đi.)


B. I would like to learn to paint, but I have not found an effective way. Should I take a course at my local college? Please, give me some advice.

Giải: Quan điểm (Agree / Disagree)

I couldn’t agree more that you should take a course at your local college for various reasons. Most importantly, learning directly from experienced instructors allows you to receive personalized feedback and guidance suitable to your level and goals. Moreover, colleges often provide access to facilities and specialized tools that may not be available at home.

(Dịch: Tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý rằng bạn nên tham gia một khóa học tại trường cao đẳng địa phương vì nhiều lý do. Quan trọng nhất, việc học trực tiếp từ các giảng viên giàu kinh nghiệm cho phép bạn nhận được phản hồi và hướng dẫn cá nhân hóa phù hợp với trình độ và mục tiêu của mình. Hơn nữa, các trường cao đẳng thường cung cấp quyền truy cập vào các cơ sở vật chất và công cụ chuyên dụng mà có thể không có sẵn ở nhà.)


C. Street art – where people paint on the building – is becoming popular. However, some people criticize that it is bad. What is your opinion?

Giải: Quan điểm (Agree / Disagree)

I don’t see eye to eye that street art is bad for various reasons. Most importantly, it broadens our knowledge by introducing diverse cultural stories and historical references on public walls. Moreover, it strengthens relationships as artists and locals collaborate, fostering community bonds and mutual understanding.

(Dịch: Tôi không đồng ý rằng nghệ thuật đường phố xấu vì nhiều lý do. Quan trọng nhất, nó mở rộng kiến thức bằng cách giới thiệu câu chuyện văn hóa và lịch sử đa dạng trên tường công cộng. Hơn nữa, nó củng cố mối quan hệ khi nghệ sĩ và cư dân hợp tác, xây dựng tình đoàn kết cộng đồng.)

Giải: Activity & hobby

I always enjoy reading books at various times of day. One of my favorites is reading on my sofa, where I usually spend around two hours after dinner. This is because it helps me let my hair down after a busy week.

Dịch : "Tôi luôn thích đọc sách vào nhiều thời điểm trong ngày. Một sở thích là đọc trên ghế sofa, nơi tôi thường dành khoảng hai giờ sau bữa tối. Điều này là vì nó giúp tôi thả lỏng sau tuần bận rộn."


B. Hi! I would like to give my friend a book. What would you suggest for me to buy?

Giải: Đưa về chủ đề lợi ích 

I would like to recommend "The Alchemist" by Paulo Coelho. Firstly, it's an inspiring story about following dreams, perfect for motivation. Moreover, it's short and easy to read, so your friend can finish it quickly and feel accomplished.

(Dịch: Tôi muốn gợi ý 'Nhà giả kim' của Paulo Coelho. Đầu tiên, đó là câu chuyện truyền cảm hứng về theo đuổi ước mơ, rất phù hợp để động viên. Hơn nữa, sách ngắn dễ đọc, bạn của sẽ hoàn thành nhanh và cảm thấy thành tựu.)


C. Do online books replace traditional books? What do you think about that?

Giải: Quan điểm ((Agree / Disagree)

From my point of view, online books can replace traditional books. First of all, they are environmentally friendly and save paper. Moreover, they are easy to carry anywhere without heavy bags.

(Dịch: Theo tôi, sách trực tuyến có thể thay thế sách truyền thống. Trước hết, chúng thân thiện với môi trường và tiết kiệm giấy. Hơn nữa, chúng dễ dàng mang theo mọi lúc mọi nơi mà không cần túi xách nặng nề.)

A. I used to learn French and found it very interesting. Tell me about a memory you have with a foreign language?

Giải: Experience

If my memory serves me right, it was 2 years ago. I had a long journey alone to China by plane. On this trip, I used Chinese to make new friends who shared their culture. At that time, I felt very excited and happy.

(Dịch: Nếu nhớ đúng, đó là 2 năm trước. Tôi đi máy bay một mình đến Trung Quốc. Trong chuyến, tôi dùng tiếng Trung kết bạn mới, họ kể về văn hóa. Lúc ấy, tôi rất phấn khích và vui.)


B. I am very forgetful. Can you give me some tips on how to remember new words?

Giải: Quan điểm

From my point of view, remembering new words is easy with these tips. First of all, use flashcards to review every day. Moreover, practice in sentences to make them stick.

(Dịch: Theo tôi, việc ghi nhớ từ mới rất dễ dàng với những mẹo này. Trước hết, hãy sử dụng thẻ ghi nhớ để ôn tập mỗi ngày. Hơn nữa, hãy luyện tập thành câu để ghi nhớ lâu hơn.)


C. Some people learn English through videos and reading books. However, there are also many private classes and teachers. What do you think is the most effective way to learn?

Giải:

From my point of view, learning English through videos and reading books is most effective. First of all, it saves time because I can study flexibly at my own pace. Secondly, it broadens my knowledge with diverse topics and authentic language.

Dịch: "Theo tôi, học tiếng Anh qua video và đọc sách là hiệu quả nhất. Thứ nhất, nó tiết kiệm thời gian vì tôi có thể học linh hoạt theo tốc độ của mình. Thứ hai, nó mở rộng kiến ​​thức của tôi với nhiều chủ đề đa dạng và ngôn ngữ thực tế."

questions.content: You are a member of a Beautiful Homes Club. You are talking to other members in the club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.
questions.suggestion:
A: I have a bad relationship with my neighbors because they often make noise. Tell me how is your relationship with your neighbors?

LỜI GIẢI: I highly recommend you talk to them politely and friendly to resolve that bad problem. You can ask them to turn down the volume when they listen to music to avoid noise pollution. In particular, they should keep it quiet at night so that other neighbors can feel relaxed and comfortable after a day of hard work.

(DỊCH: Tôi thực sự khuyên bạn nên nói chuyện với họ một cách lịch sự và thân thiện để giải quyết vấn đề tồi tệ đó. Bạn có thể yêu cầu họ giảm âm lượng khi nghe nhạc để tránh ô nhiễm tiếng ồn. Đặc biệt, họ nên giữ im lặng vào ban đêm để những người hàng xóm khác có thể cảm thấy thư thái, dễ chịu sau một ngày làm việc vất vả.)


B: Do you prefer living in old buildings or modern buildings? Why?

Giải: Lợi ích, bất lợi, quan điểm

Honestly, I prefer living in modern buildings because it brings many advantages. First and foremost, it helps me save time thanks to smart appliances. Besides, home maintenance is cheaper in the long run.

(Dịch: Thành thật mà nói, tôi thích sống trong những tòa nhà hiện đại vì nó mang lại nhiều lợi ích. Trước hết, nó giúp tôi tiết kiệm thời gian nhờ các thiết bị thông minh. Hơn nữa, về lâu dài, chi phí bảo trì nhà cũng rẻ hơn.)


C: The house should be designed in a way that is good for the environment. Do you agree?

Giải: Quan điểm (đồng ý/không đồng ý)

I couldn't agree more that the house should be designed in a way that is good for the environment for various reasons. First of all, it protects the environment by saving resources. Moreover, it saves money in the long run.

(Dịch: Tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý rằng ngôi nhà nên được thiết kế theo hướng thân thiện với môi trường vì nhiều lý do. Trước hết, nó bảo vệ môi trường bằng cách tiết kiệm tài nguyên. Hơn nữa, về lâu dài, nó còn tiết kiệm tiền.)

questions.content: You are a member of a Photography Club. You are talking to three other members in the Photography Club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.
questions.suggestion:

My favorite photo is the picture of a waterfall in Cao Bang province, which I took last month with my friend. I love looking at it in my free time because it always makes me feel happy and relaxed.

I always enjoy doing various activities. One of my favorites is taking photo of the World’s natural beauty, where we usually spend around two hours per week to take photos of sunrise and sunset on the sea or in forests because it helps improve my mood.


C: Is it good to take pictures with the phone?

questions.content: You are a member of a photography club. You are talking to three other members in the photography club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.
questions.suggestion:
A: Hi! Welcome to the club. How to have a beautiful picture?

Giải: Quan điểm / lời khuyên

From my point of view, having a beautiful picture is easy with these tips. First of all, we should time it correctly to capture special moments. Besides, pay attention to composition for eye-catching content.

(Dịch: Theo tôi, việc có một bức ảnh đẹp thật dễ dàng với những mẹo này. Trước hết, chúng ta nên căn thời gian chính xác để bắt được những khoảnh khắc đặc biệt. Bên cạnh đó, hãy chú ý đến bố cục để có nội dung bắt mắt.)


B: I often save my photos as files on my computer or print them out. How do you save your photos?

Dịch: Sở thích

I often save photos on my cell phone because of various reasons. Firstly, it's super convenient as I can access them anytime, anywhere. In addition, it saves space on my computer.

(Dịch: Tôi thường lưu ảnh trên điện thoại di động vì nhiều lý do. Thứ nhất, nó cực kỳ tiện lợi vì tôi có thể truy cập chúng mọi lúc, mọi nơi. Ngoài ra, nó còn tiết kiệm dung lượng trên máy tính của tôi.)


C: What skills do you need to take good photos?

From my point of view, taking good photos for various reasons. First of all, the skill to take a good photo is patience. questions.content: You are a member of a Music Club. You are talking to three other members in the Music Club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.
questions.suggestion:

Gợi ý: Sở thích

I always enjoy listening to music at various times of the day. One of my favorites is listening alone every night because it helps me let my hair down when I feel tired.

(Dịch: Tôi luôn thích nghe nhạc vào nhiều thời điểm khác nhau trong ngày. Một trong những sở thích của tôi là nghe nhạc một mình mỗi tối vì nó giúp tôi thư giãn khi cảm thấy mệt mỏi.)


B: I plan to give my son music lessons but he doesn't like it. What should I do?

Giải:

From my point of view, you should encourage him gently with these ideas. First of all, start with short sessions of 10 minutes. Moreover, make lessons fun by playing games.

(Dịch: Theo tôi, bạn nên nhẹ nhàng khuyến khích con bằng những ý tưởng này. Trước hết, hãy bắt đầu với những buổi học ngắn khoảng 10 phút. Hơn nữa, hãy làm cho bài học trở nên thú vị bằng cách chơi trò chơi.)


C: Do you agree that music is important in culture? 

Giải: Quan điểm (đồng ý/ không đồng ý)

(Dịch: Tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý rằng âm nhạc rất quan trọng trong văn hóa vì nhiều lý do. Trước hết, nó phần nào phản ánh đặc trưng văn hóa của từng quốc gia. Ngoài ra, nó có ý nghĩa tinh thần lớn lao đối với mọi người.)

I'm keen on playing and watching sports programs for various reasons. Firstly, I always feel comfortable when I join in a conversation with people who have the same interests. Secondly, playing sports with friends helps me improve my health effectively without feeling bored.

questions.content: You are a member of a Social Club You are talking to three other members in the  Social Club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.
questions.suggestion:
A: Where did you meet your friends for the first time and how did you become friends?

Giải:

If my memory serves me right, the first time I met my best friend was when I joined an English class 2 years ago. We were divided into a group to do an assignment. We talked a lot about tips for learning English. At that time, I was so excited and had so much fun.

(Giải: Nếu tôi nhớ không nhầm, lần đầu tiên tôi gặp người bạn thân nhất của mình là khi tôi tham gia một lớp tiếng Anh cách đây 2 năm. Chúng tôi được chia thành một nhóm để làm bài tập. Chúng tôi đã nói rất nhiều về các mẹo học tiếng Anh. Lúc đó, tôi đã rất hào hứng và vui vẻ.)


B: I have just moved to the city and want to make some friends. Can you give me some advice?

Giải: Quan điểm/ lời khuyên

From my point of view, making friends in a new city is easy with these tips. First of all, you should use social media to make friends. Moreover, you can volunteer at local charities to connect.

(Dịch: Theo tôi, việc kết bạn ở một thành phố mới thật dễ dàng với những mẹo này. Trước hết, bạn nên sử dụng mạng xã hội để kết bạn. Hơn nữa, bạn có thể tham gia tình nguyện tại các tổ chức từ thiện địa phương để kết nối.)


C: It is much easier to make new friends these days because of computers and mobile phones. Do you agree? Why or why not?

(Dịch: Tôi không đồng tình với quan điểm cho rằng ngày nay việc kết bạn mới dễ dàng hơn nhiều nhờ máy tính và điện thoại di động vì nhiều lý do. Quan trọng nhất là màn hình làm giảm khả năng giao tiếp trực tiếp. Hơn nữa, trò chuyện trực tuyến thiếu đi cảm xúc thực sự.)

questions.content: You are a member of a Walking club. You are talking to three other members in the Walking club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.
questions.suggestion:
A: I usually go for a walk. Do you like walking?

Gợi ý: Sở thích/ hoạt động

I always enjoy various activities. One of my favorites is walking with best friends in the park, where we spend 1 hour after work. This is because it helps improve our health day by day.

(Dịch: Tôi luôn thích nhiều hoạt động khác nhau. Một trong những hoạt động yêu thích của tôi là đi bộ cùng bạn thân trong công viên, nơi chúng tôi dành 1 tiếng sau giờ làm việc. Bởi vì nó giúp cải thiện sức khỏe của chúng tôi từng ngày.)


B: I like walking but when it rains I get wet. Tell me about a time you had a bad experience while hiking.

Gợi ý: Trải nghiệm

If my memory serves me right, it was 2 weeks ago. I decided to go hiking along a mountain which is quite far from my house. Suddenly, it rained but I forgot to bring a raincoat. At that time, I felt very uncomfortable because I got wet.

(Dịch: Nếu tôi nhớ không nhầm thì đó là 2 tuần trước. Tôi quyết định đi bộ đường dài dọc theo một ngọn núi khá xa nhà. Bỗng nhiên trời đổ mưa nhưng tôi quên mang theo áo mưa. Lúc đó, tôi cảm thấy rất khó chịu vì bị ướt.)


C: Walking is the best form of exercise. What do you think when many people walk and know it's good for their health?

Gợi ý: Quan điểm- Đồng ý/ không đồng ý

I couldn’t agree more that walking is the best exercise for various reasons. Firstly, it improves health and weight by burning calories. Moreover, many people choose walking to improve their mood after work.

(Dịch: Tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý rằng đi bộ là bài tập tốt nhất vì nhiều lý do. Thứ nhất, nó cải thiện sức khỏe và cân nặng bằng cách đốt cháy calo. Hơn nữa, nhiều người chọn đi bộ để cải thiện tâm trạng sau giờ làm việc.)

questions.content: You are communicating with other members of the club in the chat room. Reply to their questions. Write in sentences. Use 30–40 words per answer.
questions.suggestion:
A: I prefer to go to the countryside for a walk. Walking in the city is stressful and noisy. What do you think?

Giải: Quan điểm - Đồng ý/ không đồng ý

I couldn’t agree more that countryside walks are better than city ones for various reasons. Firstly, the countryside is peaceful with fresh air. Besides, the roads in the countryside are open and not as noisy as in the city.

(Dịch: Tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý rằng đi bộ ở nông thôn tốt hơn đi bộ ở thành phố vì nhiều lý do. Thứ nhất, nông thôn yên bình với không khí trong lành. Hơn nữa, đường xá ở nông thôn thoáng đãng và không ồn ào như ở thành phố.)


B: In the past, people walked long distances as part of their lives. These days, they don’t walk anymore. Why?

Giải: Quan điểm

From my point of view, people walk less these days for various reasons. Firstly, modern transport like cars is faster and more convenient. Moreover, busy lifestyles leave no time for walking.

(Dịch: Theo quan điểm của tôi, mọi người ngày nay đi bộ ít hơn vì nhiều lý do. Thứ nhất, phương tiện giao thông hiện đại như ô tô nhanh hơn và tiện lợi hơn. Hơn nữa, lối sống bận rộn khiến chúng ta không còn thời gian để đi bộ.)


C: Walking is good. What are useful ways to encourage people to walk more?

Giải: Quan điểm/ lời khuyên

From my point of view, there are many useful ways to encourage people to walk more. Firstly, we can organize group walks weekly to attract people. Moreover, creating challenges can motivate people to walk daily.

(Dịch: Theo tôi, có nhiều cách hữu ích để khuyến khích mọi người đi bộ nhiều hơn. Đầu tiên, chúng ta có thể tổ chức các buổi đi bộ nhóm hàng tuần để thu hút mọi người. Hơn nữa, việc tạo ra các thử thách có thể thúc đẩy mọi người đi bộ hàng ngày.)

questions.content: You are a member of a Computer club. You are talking to other members in the club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.
questions.suggestion:
A: My grandmother doesn’t know how to use the computer. Your solutions

Gợi ý: Quan điểm/ lời khuyên

From my point of view, there are many solutions to help your grandmother use the computer. Firstly, you should teach her basic computer skills, such as typing. Besides, you can help her sign up for an elderly course.

(Dịch: Theo tôi, có nhiều giải pháp giúp bà của bạn sử dụng máy tính. Đầu tiên, bạn nên dạy bà những kỹ năng máy tính cơ bản, chẳng hạn như đánh máy. Ngoài ra, bạn có thể giúp bà đăng ký một khóa học dành cho người cao tuổi.)


B: The last time you used your computer. Your purpose.

If my memory serves me right, it was one week ago. I had a long journey alone to Hue by plane. On the way to the hotel, I received a sudden request from my boss so I opened my laptop to complete an urgent report. After finishing the work, I felt very relieved.

(Dịch: Nếu tôi nhớ không nhầm thì đó là một tuần trước. Tôi vừa có một chuyến bay dài một mình đến Huế. Trên đường về khách sạn, tôi nhận được yêu cầu đột xuất từ ​​sếp nên tôi mở laptop ra làm báo cáo gấp. Sau khi hoàn thành công việc, tôi cảm thấy rất nhẹ nhõm.)

questions.content: You are a member of a Home Living Club. You are talking to three other members in the club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.
questions.suggestion:
A: Tell me something about your childhood home.

Gợi ý:

My childhood home was a 3-story house in Ha Noi. It was not very spacious, but I liked the convenience of living there, including a small kitchen, three bedrooms, and two bathrooms. Whenever I had free time, I used to relax by listening to music on my bed.

(Dịch: Ngôi nhà thời thơ ấu của tôi là một căn nhà ba tầng ở Hà Nội. Nó không rộng rãi lắm, nhưng tôi thích sự tiện nghi khi sống ở đó, với một căn bếp nhỏ, ba phòng ngủ và hai phòng tắm. Mỗi khi rảnh rỗi, tôi thường thư giãn bằng cách nghe nhạc trên giường.)


B: Which do you prefer living in, the country or the city, and why?

Giải: Lợi ích/ bất lợi/ quan điểm

Honestly, I prefer living in the city because it brings many advantages. First and foremost, the city provides many services and amenities, which cannot be found in the country. Besides, it helps me stay close to friends and pursue my favorite job.

(Dịch: Thành thật, tôi thích sống thành phố vì nhiều lợi ích. Trước hết, thành phố cung cấp dịch vụ tiện ích không có ở nông thôn. Mặt khác, nó giúp tôi gần bạn bè và theo đuổi công việc yêu thích.)


C: The benefits of living in the city.

Giải: Quan điểm

From my point of view, living in the city has lots of benefits. First of all, most universities are located in cities so there are more jobs. Moreover, city transport is convenient. 

(Dịch: Theo quan điểm của tôi, sống ở thành phố có rất nhiều lợi ích. Trước hết, hầu hết các trường đại học đều nằm ở thành phố nên có nhiều việc làm hơn. Hơn nữa, giao thông công cộng ở thành phố rất thuận tiện.)

questions.content: You are a member of a Home Living Club. You are talking to three other members in the club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.
questions.suggestion:
A: You have to stay in the bedroom but have to share with your brother. How do you feel?

Gợi ý:

I'm fond of sharing a bedroom with my brother for various reasons. Firstly, we play games and laugh together every evening. Secondly, he helps me when I have homework problems.

(Dịch: Tôi thích ở chung phòng ngủ với anh trai vì nhiều lý do. Thứ nhất, chúng tôi cùng nhau chơi trò chơi và cười đùa mỗi tối. Thứ hai, anh ấy giúp tôi khi tôi gặp vấn đề về bài tập về nhà.)


B: It is better to live in the city than in the countryside. Do you agree? Why?

Gợi ý: Quan điểm - Đồng ý/ không đồng ý

I couldn’t agree more that living in the city is better than in the countryside for various reasons. Firstly, cities offer more jobs and opportunities. Moreover, infrastructure in urban areas such as schools and hospitals is also more modern.

(Dịch: Tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý rằng sống ở thành phố tốt hơn ở nông thôn vì nhiều lý do. Thứ nhất, thành phố mang lại nhiều việc làm và cơ hội hơn. Hơn nữa, cơ sở hạ tầng ở khu vực thành thị như trường học và bệnh viện cũng hiện đại hơn.)


C: Nowadays, old buildings are demolished and replaced with modern buildings. I feel we should protect historic buildings. What do you think?

Gợi ý: Quan điểm - Đồng ý/ không đồng ý

I don’t see eye to eye that we should protect historic buildings for various reasons. Most importantly, old buildings are often cramped and unsafe. Besides, many old buildings affect the aesthetics and modern appearance of some cities.

(Dịch: Tôi không đồng tình với quan điểm rằng chúng ta nên bảo vệ các công trình kiến ​​trúc lịch sử vì nhiều lý do. Quan trọng nhất là các công trình kiến ​​trúc cổ thường chật chội và không an toàn. Hơn nữa, nhiều công trình kiến ​​trúc cổ ảnh hưởng đến tính thẩm mỹ và diện mạo hiện đại của một số thành phố.)

B: I am going to join a debate in front of 50 people next week. How can I make a good impression?

Giải: Quan điểm - Lời khuyên

From my point of view, there are various ways to make a good impression in the debate. First of all, you should prepare what you need to say that day. Moreover, you should practice speaking confidently and using eye contact with the audience.

(Dịch: Theo tôi, có nhiều cách để tạo ấn tượng tốt trong buổi tranh luận. Trước hết, bạn nên chuẩn bị những gì cần nói trong ngày hôm đó. Hơn nữa, bạn nên luyện tập nói tự tin và giao tiếp bằng mắt với khán giả.)

(Dịch: Tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý rằng bạn nên cân nhắc hai mặt trước khi quyết định vì nhiều lý do. Quan trọng nhất, điều này giúp tôi giảm thiểu sai sót trong quyết định. Hơn nữa, hiểu biết sâu sắc hơn sẽ dẫn đến những lựa chọn công bằng.)

questions.content: You are a member of a Technology club. You are talking to three other members in the Technology club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.
questions.suggestion:
A: Do you often watch movies on your laptop or go to the theater?

Gợi ý: 

Honestly, I prefer watching movies on my laptop because it brings many advantages. First and foremost, it saves time as I can watch anytime without traveling. Moreover, it's much cheaper than theater tickets.

(Dịch: Thành thật mà nói, tôi thích xem phim trên laptop hơn vì nó mang lại nhiều lợi ích. Trước hết, nó tiết kiệm thời gian vì tôi có thể xem bất cứ lúc nào mà không cần phải di chuyển. Hơn nữa, nó rẻ hơn nhiều so với vé xem phim tại rạp.)


B: Some people prefer watching movies at home to watching in the cinema. Please give your opinion.

Giải: Quan điểm

From my point of view,  some people  prefer watching movies at home for various reasons. First of all, it saves time queuing to buy tickets and waiting for movies to start. Moreover, watching movies at home also saves money on tickets and snacks.

(Dịch: Theo quan điểm của tôi, một số người thích xem phim ở nhà vì nhiều lý do. Trước hết, nó tiết kiệm thời gian xếp hàng mua vé và chờ phim bắt đầu. Hơn nữa, xem phim ở nhà cũng tiết kiệm tiền vé và đồ ăn vặt.)


C: Do you like watching TV alone or with others?

Gợi ý:

I prefer watching TV with my family for various reasons. Most importantly,  it creates great family bonding time. Last but not least, I always feel over the moon when discussing the movies I am watching with my parents.

(Dịch: Tôi thích xem TV cùng gia đình vì nhiều lý do. Quan trọng nhất là nó tạo nên khoảng thời gian gắn kết gia đình tuyệt vời. Cuối cùng nhưng không kém phần quan trọng, tôi luôn cảm thấy vô cùng hào hứng khi bàn luận về những bộ phim mình đang xem với bố mẹ.)

Thứ nhất, mọi thứ đều tiện lợi với điện thoại, chẳng hạn như gọi đồ ăn, gọi taxi và thanh toán hóa đơn. Hơn nữa, nó giúp chúng ta nhìn thấy và nói chuyện với nhau dù cách xa hàng ngàn dặm.)

questions.content: You are a member of a Science Club You are talking to three other members in the  Science Club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.
questions.suggestion:
A: Why did you decide to join our Science Club? How often can you go to the club?

Gợi ý:

I'm interested in joining this Science Club because it brings many benefits. First of all, it broadens my perspective and expands my knowledge in science. Moreover, I can meet new people and make friends with them who share my similar interests. I can take part in this club on weekends.

(DỊCH: Tôi quan tâm đến việc tham gia Câu lạc bộ Khoa học này vì nó mang lại nhiều lợi ích. Trước hết, nó mở rộng tầm nhìn và kiến ​​thức khoa học của tôi. Hơn nữa, tôi có thể gặp gỡ và kết bạn với những người có cùng sở thích. Tôi có thể tham gia câu lạc bộ này vào cuối tuần.)


B: In the past, you learned about Science in school. Do you remember something about Science?

Gợi ý:

I still remember some knowledge about Science, these are the basics. Firstly, the Earth revolves around the Sun. Secondly, water boils at 100 degrees Celsius. Finally, information about the Big Bang.

(Dịch: Tôi vẫn còn nhớ một số kiến ​​thức về Khoa học, đây là những kiến ​​thức cơ bản. Thứ nhất, Trái Đất quay quanh Mặt Trời. Thứ hai, nước sôi ở 100 độ C. Cuối cùng, thông tin về Vụ Nổ Lớn.)


C: Who is your favorite inventor or scientist? Why?

Gợi ý:

I’d love to tell you about Marie Curie because she’s the one I admire the most. She is the first woman in the world to receive a Nobel Award. Moreover, she inspired me with her hard work and passion for research even during wars.

(Dịch: Tôi rất muốn kể cho bạn nghe về Marie Curie vì bà là người tôi ngưỡng mộ nhất. Bà là người phụ nữ đầu tiên trên thế giới nhận giải Nobel. Hơn nữa, bà đã truyền cảm hứng cho tôi bằng sự chăm chỉ và niềm đam mê nghiên cứu ngay cả trong thời chiến.)

Gợi ý: 

If my memory serves me right, it was 12 years ago. I had a long journey to Hue with my parents by plane. On this trip, my parents took me to the Hue Royal Antiquities Museum so that I could understand more about Vietnamese culture. At that time, I was so excited and had so much fun.

(Dịch: Nếu tôi nhớ không nhầm thì đó là 12 năm trước. Tôi đã có một chuyến đi dài đến Huế cùng bố mẹ bằng máy bay. Trong chuyến đi này, bố mẹ đã đưa tôi đến Bảo tàng Cổ vật Cung đình Huế để tôi có thể hiểu thêm về văn hóa Việt Nam. Lúc đó, tôi đã rất hào hứng và vui vẻ.)

Gợi ý: 

Honestly, I prefer a history museum for various reasons. First and foremost, it broadens my knowledge of ancient cultures and historical events. Besides, I always feel inspired when admiring historical artifacts.

(Dịch: Thành thật mà nói, tôi thích bảo tàng lịch sử vì nhiều lý do. Trước hết, nó giúp tôi mở rộng kiến ​​thức về các nền văn hóa cổ đại và các sự kiện lịch sử. Hơn nữa, tôi luôn cảm thấy hứng khởi khi chiêm ngưỡng các hiện vật lịch sử.)

Gợi ý: Quan điểm - Đồng ý/ không đồng ý

(Dịch: Tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý rằng triển lãm trực tuyến sẽ thành công vì nhiều lý do. Quan trọng nhất là công nghệ giúp mọi người đến gần hơn với hiện vật. Bên cạnh đó, các tính năng tương tác cũng thu hút sự chú ý, đặc biệt là giới trẻ.)

questions.content: You are a member of a Food Club. You are talking to three other members in the club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.
questions.suggestion:
A. Tell me about the most memorable meal of your life.

Gợi ý:

The meal that I will never forget happened last Monday when I met a friend of mine again. We had not seen each other for 10 years and we were so happy to be able to sit and enjoy dinner together. That dinner consisted of some of the dishes we used to eat when we were young.

(Dịch: Bữa ăn mà tôi sẽ không bao giờ quên diễn ra vào thứ Hai tuần trước, khi tôi gặp lại một người bạn. Chúng tôi đã không gặp nhau 10 năm rồi, và chúng tôi rất vui khi được ngồi lại và thưởng thức bữa tối cùng nhau. Bữa tối đó gồm những món chúng tôi vẫn thường ăn hồi nhỏ.)


B. Some people like to eat out with friends, do you like eating out or eating at home?

Gợi ý:

Honestly, I prefer eating at home for various reasons. First and foremost, eating at home is often cheaper than eating out. Besides, I can cook with my family, which strengthens our bonds and creates cozy memories.

(Dịch: Thành thật mà nói, tôi thích ăn ở nhà vì nhiều lý do. Trước hết, ăn ở nhà thường rẻ hơn ăn ngoài. Hơn nữa, tôi có thể nấu ăn cùng gia đình, điều này giúp gắn kết tình cảm và tạo nên những kỷ niệm ấm áp.)


C. Nowadays, people in other countries have too many unhealthy food choices, should there be a tax on fast food to improve this situation, why?

Gợi ý:

I couldn’t agree more that there should be a tax on fast food for various reasons. Most importantly, higher prices make people choose healthier food. Besides, the government can use tax money to fund public health programs.

(Dịch: Tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý rằng nên đánh thuế đồ ăn nhanh vì nhiều lý do. Quan trọng nhất là giá cả tăng cao sẽ khiến mọi người lựa chọn thực phẩm lành mạnh hơn. Bên cạnh đó, chính phủ có thể sử dụng tiền thuế để tài trợ cho các chương trình y tế công cộng.)

questions.content: You are a member of a Travel club. You are talking to three other members in the Travel club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.
questions.suggestion:
A: Tell me a time you had a trip in bad weather.

Gợi ý: 

If my memory serves me right, it was 2 years ago. I had a long journey to Hue with my family by plane. Throughout the first day of this trip, we had to stay at our hotel most of the time and couldn't visit anywhere because it rained cats and dogs. At that time I felt kind of bored and frustrated.

(Dịch: Nếu tôi nhớ không nhầm thì đó là 2 năm trước. Tôi và gia đình đã có một chuyến đi dài đến Huế bằng máy bay. Suốt ngày đầu tiên của chuyến đi, chúng tôi phải ở khách sạn hầu hết thời gian và không thể đi đâu được vì trời mưa như trút nước. Lúc đó tôi cảm thấy hơi buồn chán và bực bội.)


B: Traveling a long distance by some means of transportation is not good for the environment. Do you agree?

Gợi ý : Quan điểm- Đồng ý/ không đồng ý

I couldn’t agree more that traveling a long distance by some means of transportation is not good for the environment for various reasons. Most importantly, vehicles release carbon emissions causing pollution. Secondly, people can throw trash out of their way which pollutes.

(Dịch: Tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý rằng việc di chuyển đường dài bằng một số phương tiện giao thông không tốt cho môi trường vì nhiều lý do. Quan trọng nhất là xe cộ thải ra khí thải carbon gây ô nhiễm. Thứ hai, mọi người có thể vứt rác bừa bãi trên đường đi, gây ô nhiễm.)


C: What are the most interesting places to visit in your country?

Gợi ý 

In my opinion, Ha Long Bay is one of the most interesting places. It is 150 kilometers from Hanoi, with stunning limestone islands. Even though it's always crowded with tourists, I still love it because the seafood is so fresh.

(Dịch: Theo tôi, Vịnh Hạ Long là một trong những nơi thú vị nhất. Cách Hà Nội 150km, nơi đây có những đảo đá vôi tuyệt đẹp. Mặc dù luôn đông đúc khách du lịch, tôi vẫn yêu thích nơi này vì hải sản rất tươi ngon.)

Đây là kỳ nghỉ yêu thích nhất của tôi vì nó giúp tôi mở rộng tầm nhìn và hiểu biết về văn hóa và lịch sử Việt Nam.)

I'm crazy about watching music videos of my favorite singers because it brings various benefits. Firstly, I can spend hours sitting in front of the screen to relieve stress after a tiring day. Besides, it helps me learn new trends and feel happier.

(Dịch: Tôi rất thích xem video ca nhạc của các ca sĩ mình yêu thích vì nó mang lại sự thư giãn và thú vị. Thứ nhất, tôi có thể dành hàng giờ ngồi trước màn hình để giải tỏa căng thẳng sau một ngày mệt mỏi. Hơn nữa, nó còn giúp tôi học hỏi những xu hướng mới và cảm thấy vui vẻ hơn.)


B: Do you like watching TV alone or with others?

Gợi ý:

I prefer watching TV with my family for various reasons. Most importantly, it creates great family bonding time. Last but not least, I always feel over the moon when discussing the movies I am watching with my parents.

Gợi ý:

I'm crazy about learning English through watching videos because it brings me various benefits. Firstly, I spend hours watching English films to improve listening skills. Secondly, I like to learn more vocabulary by heart on some English-language channels such as BBC News, and VOA Learning English.

(Dịch: Tôi rất thích học tiếng Anh qua video vì nó mang lại cho tôi nhiều lợi ích. Thứ nhất, tôi dành hàng giờ xem phim tiếng Anh để cải thiện kỹ năng nghe. Thứ hai, tôi thích học thuộc lòng nhiều từ vựng hơn trên một số kênh tiếng Anh như BBC News và VOA Learning English.)


B: English is a popular language in the world. What are your thoughts on this idea?

Gợi ý: Quan điểm - Đồng ý/ không đồng ý

I couldn’t agree more that English is a popular language in the world for various reasons. Most importantly, it opens job opportunities globally. Besides, it helps people easily access the world's huge online knowledge base.

(DỊCH: Tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý rằng tiếng Anh là ngôn ngữ phổ biến trên thế giới vì nhiều lý do. Quan trọng nhất, nó mở ra nhiều cơ hội việc làm trên toàn cầu. Bên cạnh đó, nó giúp mọi người dễ dàng tiếp cận kho kiến ​​thức trực tuyến khổng lồ của thế giới.)


C: When do you usually use English?

Gợi ý:

I frequently use English at work for various reasons. Firstly, my job requires communicating with foreign customers every day. Secondly, my company is a multinational company with many foreign colleagues.

(Dịch: Tôi thường xuyên sử dụng tiếng Anh trong công việc vì nhiều lý do. Thứ nhất, công việc của tôi đòi hỏi phải giao tiếp với khách hàng nước ngoài hàng ngày. Thứ hai, công ty tôi là một công ty đa quốc gia với nhiều đồng nghiệp nước ngoài.)

questions.content:
You are a member of a book club. You received this email from the club.

"Dear member,

From next month we will no longer be able to continue our offer of one free book every month. Also, because of problems with our delivery service, please expect a wait of 4-6 weeks before your order arrives."
questions.suggestion:
1. Thư thân mật

Gợi ý:

Hello Lan,

How are you?

I am writing to tell you about recent news from the club. Did you know that from next month the club will no longer be able to continue our offer of one free book every month?

I was so disappointed when I heard about the news.

I will write a letter to the manager. What should I write? Your input would mean a lot to me.

Drop me a line soon.

Bye for now,

Mia”


2. Thư trang trọng

Gợi ý:

Dear Sir,

I hope this email finds you well. My full name is Nguyen Mai Anh, and I have been a member of the Book Club for more than one year.

I am writing to express my feelings and give my suggestions regarding your previous email.

According to the announcement, we will no longer be able to continue our offer of one free book every month. Besides, due to delivery problems, orders will now take 4-6 weeks to arrive.

To be honest, I was rather disappointed at first because I love receiving a free book monthly to broaden my knowledge and keep my reading habit alive.

From my perspective, I would recommend that the club introduce monthly discount codes – this keeps members excited and reading regularly. In addition, the club should consider switching to a new delivery partner because faster service would boost satisfaction and cut complaints.

I look forward to hearing your response if my recommendations are accepted.

Best regards,

Nguyen Mai Anh

Theo quan điểm của tôi, tôi đề xuất câu lạc bộ giới thiệu mã giảm giá hàng tháng – điều này giữ thành viên hào hứng và đọc đều đặn. Ngoài ra, câu lạc bộ nên cân nhắc chuyển sang đối tác giao hàng mới vì dịch vụ nhanh hơn sẽ tăng sự hài lòng và giảm khiếu nại.

Tôi mong nhận phản hồi nếu các gợi ý của tôi được chấp nhận.

questions.content:
You are a member of a college. You received this email from the college administrator.

"Dear members,

Nowadays more and more new words and phrases are added to the language, so many people have strong reactions to this issue. Some people gladly accept others and argue that there should be rules for language. Write a letter to your friend and the club manager to express your views and explain why so many people react like this."
questions.suggestion:
Hello Lan,

How are you?

I am writing to tell you about recent news from the club. Did you know that they're asking for opinions on adding more new words and phrases to the language?

I was so worried when I heard about the news.

I will write a letter to the manager. What should I write? Your input would mean a lot to me.

Drop me a line soon.

Bye for now,

Mia

TRANG TRỌNG

Dear Sir/Madam,

I hope this email finds you well. My full name is Nguyen Mai Anh, and I have been a member of the college for more than two years.

I am writing to express my feelings and give my suggestions regarding your previous email.

According to the announcement, nowadays more and more new words and phrases are added to the language, so many people have strong reactions to this issue. Some people gladly accept them while others argue that there should be rules for the language.

To be honest, I was quite surprised at first because I think change is normal. However, I totally understand why so many people react strongly. Firstly, the older generation feels that too many new words destroy the purity and elegance of the language they have known and loved all their lives. Secondly, without clear rules, the language can quickly become messy and difficult for everyone to understand properly, especially for elderly people and learners.

From my perspective, I completely agree that we should have some basic rules for the language. Rules will help protect its beauty, make communication clearer and ensure that everyone – young and old – can still enjoy and use it comfortably for many years to come.

I look forward to hearing your response if my recommendations are accepted.

Best regards,

Nguyen Mai Anh

Kính gửi Quý Ông/Bà,

Tôi hy vọng email này sẽ đến tay Quý Ông/Bà. Tôi tên đầy đủ là Nguyen Mai Anh, và tôi đã là thành viên của trường hơn hai năm.

Thành thật mà nói, ban đầu tôi khá ngạc nhiên vì tôi nghĩ sự thay đổi là bình thường. Tuy nhiên, tôi hoàn toàn hiểu tại sao nhiều người lại phản ứng mạnh mẽ như vậy. Thứ nhất, thế hệ lớn tuổi cảm thấy rằng quá nhiều từ mới sẽ phá hủy sự thuần khiết và tao nhã của ngôn ngữ mà họ đã biết và yêu thích suốt cuộc đời. Thứ hai, nếu không có quy tắc rõ ràng, ngôn ngữ có thể nhanh chóng trở nên lộn xộn và khó hiểu đối với tất cả mọi người, đặc biệt là người cao tuổi và người học.

Theo quan điểm của tôi, tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý rằng chúng ta nên có một số quy tắc cơ bản cho ngôn ngữ. Quy tắc sẽ giúp bảo vệ vẻ đẹp của nó, giúp giao tiếp rõ ràng hơn và đảm bảo rằng tất cả mọi người - cả trẻ lẫn già - vẫn có thể tận hưởng và sử dụng nó một cách thoải mái trong nhiều năm tới.

Tôi rất mong nhận được phản hồi của quý vị nếu đề xuất của tôi được chấp nhận.

questions.content:
Write a short email (about 50 words) to your friend, and a longer email (120-150 words) to the president of the club.

"Dear Member, this year we are planning a campaign to encourage young children to think more about nature and the natural world. Unfortunately, a lot of children prefer staying indoors and playing computer games. How can we get them to spend more time outdoors and explore? Please send us your ideas for encouraging young people to become more engaged with nature. Also, what do you think is the best way for us to communicate our messages to them?"
questions.suggestion:
Hello Lan,

How are you?

I am writing to tell you about recent news from the club. Did you know that our club is planning a campaign to encourage young children to think more about nature and the natural world?

I was so excited when I heard about the news.

I will write a letter to the manager. What should I write? Your input would mean a lot to me.

Drop me a line soon.

Bye for now,

Mia


TRANG TRỌNG:

﻿Dear Sir,

I hope this email finds you well. My full name is Nguyen Mai Anh, and I have been a member of the Nature Club for more than one year.

I am writing to express my feelings and give my suggestions regarding your previous email.

According to the announcement, the club is planning a campaign to encourage young children to spend more time outdoors and explore nature. Besides, you asked for members’ ideas on how to get them engaged and the best ways to communicate our messages.

To be honest, I was truly inspired at first because this campaign can really change children’s habits.

From my perspective, I would recommend that the club organize exciting outdoor events such as nature walks, camping trips, and environmental workshops to get children interested. In addition, the club should use popular social media platforms to share fun stories, photos, and short videos of real nature experiences, which would inspire kids to step outside.

I look forward to hearing your response if my recommendations are accepted.

Best regards,

Nguyen Mai Anh.

Tôi hy vọng email này đến tay ông trong tình trạng tốt. Tên đầy đủ của tôi là Nguyen Mai Anh, và tôi đã là thành viên của Câu lạc bộ Thiên Nhiên hơn một năm.

Theo thông báo, câu lạc bộ đang lên kế hoạch cho một chiến dịch nhằm khuyến khích trẻ nhỏ dành nhiều thời gian hơn ở ngoài trời và khám phá thiên nhiên. Bên cạnh đó, bạn đã hỏi ý kiến ​​các thành viên về cách thu hút sự tham gia của các em và cách tốt nhất để truyền tải thông điệp của chúng ta.

Thành thật mà nói, ban đầu tôi thực sự cảm thấy hứng thú vì chiến dịch này thực sự có thể thay đổi thói quen của trẻ em.

Theo quan điểm của tôi, tôi khuyến nghị câu lạc bộ nên tổ chức các sự kiện ngoài trời thú vị như đi bộ khám phá thiên nhiên, cắm trại và hội thảo về môi trường để thu hút sự quan tâm của trẻ em. Ngoài ra, câu lạc bộ nên sử dụng các nền tảng mạng xã hội phổ biến để chia sẻ những câu chuyện thú vị, hình ảnh và video ngắn về những trải nghiệm thiên nhiên thực tế, từ đó truyền cảm hứng cho trẻ em bước ra ngoài.

Tôi mong nhận được phản hồi nếu các đề xuất của tôi được chấp nhận.

Trân trọng,

Nguyen Mai Anh.

Theo quan điểm của tôi, tôi đề nghị câu lạc bộ nhanh chóng sắp xếp một buổi hỏi đáp trực tiếp ngắn trên Zoom với Malcolm G vào cuối tuần này. Ngoài ra, câu lạc bộ nên gia hạn thời hạn đặt DVD thêm một tuần để nhiều thành viên có thời gian đặt trước hơn.

Tôi mong nhận được phản hồi nếu các đề xuất của tôi được chấp nhận.

Trân trọng,

Nguyen Mai Anh.)

questions.content:
"Dear members,

We would like to design a poster to attract more people to join. We would like members to contribute ideas about colors, images and design styles for the poster. Please send us your suggestions and your reasons."
questions.suggestion:
1. Thư thân mật:

Hello Lan,

How are you?

I am writing to tell you about recent news from the club. Did you know that the club is asking members to contribute ideas for the poster?

I was so excited when I heard about the news.

I will write a letter to the manager. I suggest using blue because it looks fresh and modern. What do you think?

Drop me a line soon.

Bye for now,

Mia.


2. Thư trang trọng:

Dear Sir,

I hope this email finds you well. My full name is Nguyen Mai Anh, and I have been a member of the Designer Club for over one year.

I am writing to express my feelings regarding your previous email.

According to the announcement, the club is designing a new poster to attract more members and you asked for ideas on colours, images and design styles.

To be honest, I was really excited at first because a striking poster can bring many new members.

From my perspective, I would recommend the club use bright and energetic colours such as orange, blue and yellow because they immediately catch people’s eyes and make the poster look young and creative. In addition, the club should consider adding big, eye-catching photos of happy members doing design activities together with bold, modern fonts and a clean minimalist layout so that everyone can see at a glance how fun and professional our club is.

I look forward to hearing your response if my recommendations are accepted.

Best regards,

Nguyen Mai Anh.

(Dịch: Theo thông báo, câu lạc bộ đang thiết kế một poster mới để thu hút thêm thành viên và bạn đã hỏi ý kiến ​​về màu sắc, hình ảnh và phong cách thiết kế.

Thật lòng mà nói, ban đầu tôi rất hào hứng vì một poster ấn tượng có thể thu hút nhiều thành viên mới.

Theo quan điểm của tôi, tôi khuyến nghị câu lạc bộ nên sử dụng những màu sắc tươi sáng và năng động như cam, xanh dương và vàng vì chúng ngay lập tức thu hút sự chú ý của mọi người và khiến poster trông trẻ trung, sáng tạo. Ngoài ra, câu lạc bộ nên cân nhắc thêm những bức ảnh lớn, bắt mắt về các thành viên đang vui vẻ tham gia các hoạt động thiết kế cùng với phông chữ đậm, hiện đại và bố cục tối giản, gọn gàng để mọi người có thể thấy ngay câu lạc bộ của chúng ta vui vẻ và chuyên nghiệp như thế nào.)

questions.content:
"Dear member,

All classes will be canceled next week. Because the instructor will go on holiday. Classes will be announced later. Fees won’t be refunded to the participants."
questions.suggestion:
1. Thư thân mật:

Hello Lan,

How are you?

I am writing to tell you about recent news from the club. Did you know that all classes are canceled next week because the instructor is going on holiday?

I was so disappointed when I heard about the news.

I will write a letter to the manager. What should I write? Your input would mean a lot to me.

Drop me a line soon.

Bye for now,

Mia.


2. Thư trang trọng:

Dear Sir,

I hope this email finds you well. My full name is Nguyen Mai Anh, and I have been a member of the Cooking Club for over one year.

I am writing to express my feelings regarding your previous email.

According to the announcement, all classes are canceled next week due to the instructor's holiday. Besides, Fees won’t be refunded to the participants.

To be honest, I was quite disappointed at first because I was really looking forward to the lessons and had already planned my schedule.

From my perspective, I would recommend the club organize some alternative activities during this time, such as practice sessions or discussions, to keep the participants engaged. In addition, the club should consider hosting an online meet-up where members can share cooking experiences and photos to keep the fun going until the instructor returns.

I look forward to hearing your response if my recommendations are accepted.

Best regards,

Nguyen Mai Anh.

(Dịch: Theo thông báo, tất cả các lớp học sẽ bị hủy vào tuần tới do giáo viên nghỉ lễ. Ngoài ra, học phí sẽ không được hoàn lại cho học viên.

Thành thật mà nói, ban đầu tôi khá thất vọng vì tôi rất mong chờ các buổi học và đã lên lịch trình từ trước.

Theo quan điểm của tôi, tôi đề xuất câu lạc bộ nên tổ chức một số hoạt động thay thế trong thời gian này, chẳng hạn như các buổi thực hành hoặc thảo luận, để giữ cho học viên luôn tham gia. Ngoài ra, câu lạc bộ nên cân nhắc tổ chức một buổi gặp mặt trực tuyến, nơi các thành viên có thể chia sẻ kinh nghiệm nấu ăn và hình ảnh để duy trì không khí vui vẻ cho đến khi giáo viên quay lại.)
